title: Pulse compression
line: A 5 MHz chirp separates two targets 120 m apart.
description: Pulse compression of a 10 us chirp with 5 MHz of bandwidth. Two targets 120 m apart near 12 km overlap in the raw return; the matched filter separates them and lifts them out of the noise.
thumbnailAlt: Raw radar return and the matched-filter output resolving two targets near 12 km, rendered by RunMat
